notes.title: Next Fest with Hidalgo developers & Caye (Lovely Indies)
notes.content:
Join us for an exclusive [i]Hidalgo [/i]live stream during [b]Steam Next Fest October 2024[/b], hosted by [b]Caye [/b]from [url=https://x.com/lovelyindies]Lovely Indies[/url]!
Our team will showcase a special demo of [i]Hidalgo[/i], unveiling hidden [b]secrets[/b], narrative [b]details[/b], and a glimpse of the game’s [b]future [/b]direction. Don’t miss this chance to get [b]behind-the-scenes [/b]insights into our creative process and the elements that make [i]Hidalgo [/i]truly unique.
Plus, in just two weeks, we’ll be launching our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitethread-games/hidalgo-a-cozy-adventure-game-on-don-quijotes-world][b]Kickstarter [/b][/url]campaign to bring this adventure to life.

[b]Be part of the journey![/b]

notes.title: THE KICKSTARTER PAGE OF HIDALGO IS NOW OPEN!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

As you can see, we’re going to launch a [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitethread-games/hidalgo-a-cozy-adventure-game-on-don-quijotes-world]Kickstarter [/url]campaign[/b] very soon for Hidalgo, and the page is now open so you can [b]follow it and get notified when it starts[/b]!

In the last few months, we’ve been working hard preparing for this big moment, and we’d like you to be there with us. That’s why, even though the campaign hasn’t started yet, it would help us a lot if you clicked that [b]“Notify me on launch”[/b] button so you know when the campaign goes live!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitethread-games/hidalgo-a-cozy-adventure-game-on-don-quijotes-world][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45193182/cf83c513d7d9027b90a820312f871a954d1756c8.png[/img][/url]

We’re still finishing up all the details, but we can assure you that the campaign is going to be amazing! We’re very excited to share with you all the rewards and cool stuff you’ll be able to get if you back the campaign.

Also, in just a few days, we’ll be part of the Steam Next Fest with a [b]BRAND NEW DEMO[/b]! As you can see the next couple of months are gonna be huge for Hidalgo! This wouldn’t be possible without your support, and we hope we can continue achieving new goals with you going forward.
